roles.research_extraction: Read tracked artifacts; preserve source hashes and event kind.
roles.claim_audit: Check registry freshness, pins, scope, non-claims and source-specific gates.
roles.post_generation: Render source fields verbatim; changes require a new source revision.
roles.visual_selection: Bind existing media; hold films for the existing cold-comprehension gate.
roles.scheduling: Propose UTC slots; never dispatch or interpret a queue as authorization.
roles.metrics_ingestion: Import sourced cumulative snapshots; missing is null, never zero.
roles.attribution: Require direct post identifiers; aggregate traffic is contextual only.
roles.adversarial_review: Reject drift, invented claims, missing limits and unsupported inference.

deviations.design_said: Sequential pilot: establish the TRY-A 24-hour baseline before dispatching another thread; vary the hook only after a baseline exists.
